slides.title: A box with a number inside
slides.text: In the Machine Hall a box rides a belt through machines, and each machine does one thing to the number inside. Tally cannot see the number, so she writes a letter for it. A letter that stands for a number is called a variable.

slides.title: A line of machines is an expression
slides.text: Send n through a machine that multiplies by 3, then one that adds 5. The line makes 3n + 5, which is 5 more than 3 times n. In 3n the 3 is the coefficient, and 3n and 5 are the two terms.

focus.cue: The letter n stands for the number that goes in.
Times 3 comes first and turns n into 3n.
Plus 5 comes last, so the line makes 3n + 5.

slides.title: Work it out for n = 4
slides.text: To evaluate an expression, put a number in place of the letter and follow the machines in order. For n = 4, multiply first: 3 × 4 = 12. Then add: 12 + 5 = 17.

slides.title: Brackets change the order
slides.text: 3 times the sum of n and 4 is written 3(n + 4). The brackets say add first, then multiply the whole sum. Without them, 3n + 4 multiplies only the n. For n = 2 the first gives 18 and the second gives 10.

slides.title: Powers: a number times itself
slides.text: An exponent says how many times a number is multiplied by itself. So 5² means 5 × 5 = 25, and 2³ means 2 × 2 × 2 = 8. In 2n² only the n is squared, so for n = 3 it is 2 × 9 = 18.

slides.title: Words to know
slides.text: Four words for reading and writing expressions.

words.means: a letter that stands for a number, such as n
numbers, letters and operations with no equals sign, such as 3n + 5
a part of an expression that is added or subtracted, such as 3n
the number that multiplies a variable, such as the 3 in 3n

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Machine Line at Build the Line. Build each expression from machine blocks, then run the line and see what a number really becomes.
slides.alt: Machine Line on a phone: a board with a line of two empty machine slots between n and a question mark, and four machine blocks to choose from.
